component: OpenPGP forwarded signed window test scope

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The forwarded-signed fixture/task checks wrapper text and inline attached text, prepares the new-window promise before clicking the attachment, waits for the child display, then checks parent state again after closing the child. Scoped test recommendation: keep both window contexts explicit so viewing a signed attachment does not accidentally change the wrapper security UI. The test is source evidence for the intended isolation, not an executed security guarantee. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Attached signed-message tests must isolate parent and child window state
